title: The shadow
description:
This program reads scores until it sees `-1`, and should print the highest score. It always prints `0`.

The bug is **shadowing**: a second variable with the same name hides the first one. Find it and fix it. (In the Problems tab the compiler even warns about it.)

For the input `40 95 70 -1` the output should be:

```
Highest: 95
```
hints: `int highest{ score };` inside the `if` creates a brand-new variable that vanishes at the next `}`. You want to assign to the existing one.
